## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers for church, but then takes her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) immediately become fast friends and solemnize their friendship with an oath in the garden. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to chocolate sweets, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she is growing fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after playing late and excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her attend and promises to bake a basket of food for her, which leads [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to impulsively embrace and kiss her. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits down to do her patchwork sewing, she chatterboxingly describes her imaginative games with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her obsession with the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her prized amethyst brooch.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school through their favorite picturesque paths while discussing their classmates, including the newly returned [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During school, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a rage and smash her slate over his head. As punishment, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stand in front of the blackboard for the rest of the day, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) when he apologizes afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard and later forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to vow never to return to school. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to go back, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to seek advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imaginary future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her, bringing rare laughter to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Consoled by the romantic tragedy of their separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Channeling her energy into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), excelling in most subjects despite struggling with geometry.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) attend a political meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her dangerously ill sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). Drawing on her past experience caring for infants, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) treats Minnie May's croup throughout the night until the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) relents on her former punishment, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the post office ecstatic about being invited to tea at the manse by Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). After worrying overnight that bad weather might ruin her day, she enjoys a wonderful afternoon at the manse and later recounts the details of her visit to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's challenge to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, but she loses her balance and falls. She breaks her ankle in the fall, which causes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and looks forward to returning to school to meet the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly becomes devoted to her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically describes school activities to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including field afternoons and composition assignments. When Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) announces a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) busies herself with rehearsals despite Marilla's skepticism and finds comfort in Matthew's quiet encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) notices that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses much more plainly than her peers and decides to buy her a pretty dress for Christmas. After a flustered encounter with a shop clerk, he enlists Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to help select and sew a modern dress with puffed sleeves. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), making her performance at the school concert an absolute success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for Christmas. The local Christmas concert is a tremendous success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivering outstanding recitations and earning high praise. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's growth and secretly express their deep pride in her performance and future potential.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home from an Aid meeting expecting tea, but finds that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has failed to prepare it and is hiding upstairs in despair. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reveals she bought hair dye from a traveling peddler to turn her red hair black, but it turned green instead. After washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is forced to cut Anne's hair off, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to accept her punishment and resolve to focus on being good.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain fierce academic rivals as the school year ends. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to put away her textbooks for a restful summer. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns of Matthew's poor health, and admits to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown up.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a carefree summer outdoors on a doctor's recommendation before resuming her studies in September. Over the course of the school year, she prepares for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination under Miss Stacy's guidance and notices her own personal growth. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect on how tall and mature [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) struggles with her anxieties about passing the upcoming exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates travel to town to take the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) under Miss Stacy's guidance. After three nerve-wracking weeks of waiting back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire island with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends the day expressing deep gratitude for her success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets dressed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with Diana's help before traveling to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert. Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels intimidated by the city performers and suffers a brief moment of severe stage fright. Spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience restores her determination, leading to a successful performance, an encore, and praise from the other attendees.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> Following her successful recitation and encore, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is introduced to key guests at the concert supper, including Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). Afterward, [Billy](../character/billy.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) home under the moonlight as they discuss the evening's compliments, wealth, and contentment with their own lives.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert
